limits: This is automated semantic review of twenty typed fictional inputs for one selected age/style, not human preference or physical listening evidence.

Dialogue wording alone does not prove cancellation, deletion, source revisions, worker races, provider retention, or database durability; those require the separate recorded state/mechanical evidence.
No wrong-profile or fictional-as-real published claim was observed, but this is not broad profile-isolation or fictional-scope coverage.
No planned-event example appears in these twenty real replies; planned-versus-completed preservation is not established by this semantic review.
Proper-name anchor heuristics and sparse bilingual examples are not general entity-resolution or multilingual-recall guarantees.
